Variance of availability

Source: R/04_avail.R
var_avail.Rd

Compute the variance of the system availability at discrete time \(n\) for a finite-state ergodic Markov chain, using the asymptotic covariance structure described in Theorem 5 of Sadek and Limnios (2002).

Usage

var_avail(x, time, up)

Arguments

x

An object of class MarkovChain.

time

Integer scalar. Discrete time step \(time\) at which the variance of availability is evaluated.

up

Integer vector giving the indices of up (operational) states.

Value

A numeric scalar: the variance of the availability \(A(n)\) at time \(n\) as defined in Sadek and Limnios (2002).

References

A. Sadek and N. Limnios (2002). Asymptotic properties of estimators for nonhomogeneous Markov chains. Statistics & Probability Letters, 60(4), 1839–1850.

See also

avail(), mat_gamma(), mat_sigma()
